title: Accept/Reject intents and touch actions writing votes through the newsroom path
description: AcceptIntent / RejectIntent (current or named item) plus touch buttons. Writes use the same mutation as the web newsroom, under the user's identity, with a spoken confirmation. Verify that the votes reach the Cyclotron learning loop (PPY-c6aced). Gherkin covers the vote, an unauthorised user, and an offline backend.
